items.title: Can we better explain classification with generative models?
items.subtitle: Research Notes
items.summary: Here I ask whether generative models can help explain decisions made by generative-based classifiers.

items.title: Our latest paper on robustness of attribution methods is accepted at ICML 2026!
items.subtitle: Research Notes
items.summary: We show that SGD can improve robustness of gradient-based attribution, while attention-based attribution requires special care.
